threats.scenario: User input is reflected in HTML response without sanitization, allowing XSS attacker to exfiltrate session cookies
threats.potentialImpact: Confidentiality breach: session hijack of authenticated users; data exfiltration via cookie theft

threats.scenario: JWT verification skips signature check on tokens with 'alg: none' header
threats.potentialImpact: Authentication bypass: attacker forges admin tokens, full account takeover

improvementSuggestions: Adopt CSP with strict-dynamic + nonce-based script-src
Pin JWT library version supporting RFC 8725 (reject 'alg: none')
